Make a dressing with yogurt, mustard and lemon and toss all the ingredients.
Beetroot and walnut salad
A handful of walnuts
Boil the beetroots until soft and let them cool.
Peel and dice them.
Crumble the cheese and break the walnuts into large pieces.
Mix with olive oil and lemon and serve.
Rocket salad with sun-dried tomatoes
1 bunch rocket
6 sun-dried tomatoes
50 g tulum cheese
Soften the sun-dried tomatoes in lukewarm water if needed and slice.
Break the cheese into small pieces.
Toss all the ingredients with lemon and oil.
Baked rice pudding
1 tea glass rice
2 tablespoons starch
Boil the rice in water until soft.
Add the milk and sugar and bring to a boil while stirring.
Dissolve the starch in a little cold water and add to the mixture.
Divide into bowls and brown the tops carefully under the oven grill.
Cheese and dill poğaça
Half a tea glass vegetable oil
Mix the flour and baking powder.
Add the egg, yogurt and oil and knead a soft dough.
Add the cheese and dill and shape small poğaça.
Bake at 180°C until cooked inside and golden on top.
Potato gözleme
2 boiled potatoes
Knead a non-sticky dough with flour and water and let it rest.
Soften the onion in oil and mix with the mashed potato.
Divide the dough into balls, roll thinly, add the filling and close.
Cook the gözleme in a pan until both sides are golden.
Haydari (yogurt and cheese dip)
Mash the white cheese with a fork.
Add the mint and olive oil.
Serve cold.
Spicy ezme
1 tablespoon pomegranate molasses
Chop the tomato, pepper and onion very finely.
Wash and chop the parsley.
Drain off the excess liquid from the vegetables.
Toss with pomegranate molasses and olive oil and serve.
Celeriac soup with egg-yogurt liaison
1 celeriac
Peel the celeriac, carrot and potato and cut into small cubes.
Boil the vegetables in enough water to cover them until soft.
Whisk the yogurt, egg yolk and lemon and temper with a few spoonfuls of the hot soup.
Add the liaison slowly to the pot; heat without boiling and serve.
Tomato soup with roasted pepper
4 tomatoes
2 roasted red peppers
Add the flour and toast briefly; add the grated tomato and roasted pepper.
Add the water and cook for 15 minutes.
Blend, adjust the consistency and serve.
Yogurt soup with orzo
Boil the orzo in water until soft.
Whisk the yogurt, egg yolk and flour until smooth.
Temper the liaison by adding the hot water little by little.
Pour the mixture into the pot and heat while stirring; sprinkle with mint.
Chicken and chickpea soup
Cook the chicken through in water and shred it; keep the stock.
Briefly sauté the onion and carrot in oil.
Add the chicken stock, shredded chicken and chickpeas.
Simmer until the carrot is soft and serve hot.
Baked eggplant moussaka
Slice the eggplants, brush lightly with oil and soften in the oven at 200°C.
Fry the onion and mince in a pan; add the tomato paste and tomato.
Layer the eggplant and meat mixture in a baking dish.
Add the water and bake at 190°C for 25 minutes.
Dried okra with meat
200 g dried okra
250 g diced beef
Briefly boil the dried okra in lemony water and drain.
Brown the meat in the pot and add the onion.
Add the grated tomato and enough water to cover.
When the meat is tender, add the okra and cook without letting it fall apart.
Baked turkey köfte with vegetables
400 g minced turkey
Grate the zucchini and carrot and squeeze out the liquid.
Knead with the minced turkey, egg and breadcrumbs.
Shape small köfte and arrange on a tray lined with baking paper.
Bake at 190°C for about 25 minutes until fully cooked inside.
Baked cauliflower and chickpeas
Separate the cauliflower into small florets and wash.
Toss with the cooked chickpeas, oil and spices.
Spread in a single layer on a tray.
Bake at 200°C until the cauliflower is soft and the edges are golden.
Purslane with yogurt
1 bunch purslane
Wash the purslane thoroughly and chop.
Soften the onion in oil and add the purslane and rice.
Add a little water and keep covered until the rice is cooked.
Once lukewarm, serve with garlic yogurt.
Zucchini stuffed with bulgur
Halve the zucchini and hollow them out.
Prepare the filling by mixing onion, bulgur, grated tomato and tomato paste.
Fill the zucchini without packing too tightly and arrange in the pot.
Add hot water to come halfway up and cook until the zucchini and bulgur are soft.
Baked sea bream with lemon
2 cleaned sea bream
3 sprigs parsley
Clean the fish and pat dry with paper towels.
Slice the onion and lemon and place in a baking dish.
Oil the fish and put parsley inside.
Bake at 190°C for about 25-30 minutes until the flesh separates easily.
Shrimp and vegetable casserole
400 g cleaned shrimp
80 g kashar
Sauté the pepper and garlic in oil.
Add the chopped tomato and let the liquid reduce slightly.
Add the shrimp and cook until opaque.
Divide into casserole dishes, sprinkle with kashar and brown the top at 190°C.
Rice pilaf with dill and lemon
Toast the rice in butter for a few minutes.
Add the hot water and cook over low heat until absorbed.
After resting, mix in the chopped dill and lemon juice.
Baked erişte with cheese
Boil the erişte so it stays slightly firm and drain.
Mix the milk, egg and crumbled white cheese.
Put the erişte in a greased baking dish and toss with the sauce.
Sprinkle with kashar and bake at 180°C until golden on top.
Beetroot salad with green lentils
2 boiled beetroots
Boil the lentils without letting them fall apart and let cool.
Dice the beetroot and finely chop the spring onion.
Chop the parsley and combine with the other ingredients.
Mix with olive oil and lemon juice.
Baked quince dessert
2 quinces
4 tablespoons sugar
3 cloves
Halve the quinces and remove the cores.
Arrange in a baking dish and divide the sugar over them.
Add the water, cinnamon and cloves and cover.
Bake at 180°C until soft and serve lukewarm.
Apple cinnamon crumble
3 tablespoons butter
3 tablespoons oats
Dice the apples, mix with cinnamon and spread in a baking dish.
Rub the flour, butter, sugar and oats with your fingertips to a crumb texture.
Scatter the crumbs over the apples.
Bake at 180°C until the apples are soft and the top is golden.
Crêpes with spinach and lor cheese
150 g spinach
100 g lor
Whisk the egg, milk and flour into a runny crêpe batter.
Cook thin crêpes on both sides in a non-stick pan.
Wilt the spinach in a little oil and mix with the lor.
Divide the filling among the crêpes, fold and serve.
Baked oat and banana pancakes
1 cup oat flour
Mash the bananas and mix with the egg and milk.
Add the oat flour and baking powder.
Pour the mixture onto baking paper as small pancakes.
Bake at 180°C until cooked inside and lightly golden on top.
Mini bread rolls with olives and thyme
Half a cup lukewarm water
Half a cup pitted olives
